title: Discrete Entropic Gravity on a Cubic Graph: Emergent Newtonian and MOND Regimes with Λ-Locked Screening
description: Constructs a discrete AQUAL-like gravity operator on a cubic graph with entropic flux weighting that reproduces Newtonian (g ∝ r⁻²) and MOND-like (g ∝ r⁻¹) regimes without assuming a continuum metric. A Λ-locked bulk entropic reservoir sets the transition scale (L_Λ ∝ Λ⁻¹ᐟ²), yielding a convergent deep-MOND prefactor C ≈ 2.32 (implying a0,eff ≈ 5.4 a0), broken superposition, an external field effect, and a weak mass-scaling exponent r_trans ∝ M^0.18. A minimal cosmological stability check shows ~0.7–0.8% suppression in σ8/fσ8 via background-only modification.

discrete_gradient.description: Discrete gradient magnitude between nearest-neighbor nodes i and j on a cubic lattice with spacing a.

interpolating_function.description: AQUAL-type interpolating function governing the transition between Newtonian and MOND-like regimes.

aqual_weight.description: Edge weight between nodes i and j used in the discrete AQUAL operator.

discrete_field_equation.description: Graph-based discrete field equation analogous to AQUAL; sum over neighbors j of node i.

bulk_entropic_reservoir.description: Λ-locked bulk entropic term coupling local entropy S_i to a volume-averaged reference S_V, setting the screening scale.

screening_length.description: Yukawa-like screening length induced by the Λ-locked reservoir.

acceleration_scale.description: Acceleration scale associated with the Λ-locked screening length.

deep_mond_relation_graph.description: Graph-measured deep-MOND-like relation with a nontrivial prefactor C from discrete topology.

effective_a0.description: Effective acceleration scale implied by the discrete prefactor in the deep-MOND regime.

growth_equation.description: Linear growth ODE used for a background-only cosmological stability check with Λ-locked coupling.

key_results.main_finding: The cubic-graph entropic operator reproduces Newtonian and MOND-like scalings with a Λ-locked transition and yields a convergent prefactor C ≈ 2.32 (a0,eff ≈ 5.4 a0) and weak mass scaling r_trans ∝ M^0.18, while passing internal kill-tests and showing ~0.7–0.8% growth suppression in a minimal cosmology check.

sealed_predictions.statement: In the deep-MOND regime on increasingly refined cubic lattices, the prefactor converges to C = 2.32 ± 0.02, independent of spherical vs cubic binning.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Resolution-refinement studies on larger lattices (N > 41) showing non-convergence or a limit C ≠ 2.32.

sealed_predictions.statement: The transition radius scales with mass as r_trans ∝ M^{0.18±0.03} when Λ-locking is active.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Galaxy-scale tests of the inferred transition radius vs baryonic mass showing a slope consistent with 0.5 (MOND) and inconsistent with 0.18±0.03.

sealed_predictions.statement: Effective deep-MOND relation on the graph is g = C√(a0 g_N), implying a0,eff = C^2 a0 ≈ 5.4 a0.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Direct numerical measurement of g vs √(a0 g_N) on larger lattices or alternative boundary conditions yielding C ≈ 1.

sealed_predictions.statement: Background-only Λ-locked coupling leads to a mild suppression in growth, ε0 ≈ 0.8% at z ≈ 0.5 relative to ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Reproducing the growth-ODE with the specified background channel and finding ε0 inconsistent with ~0.5–1.0%.

kill_criteria: KC1: Failure to recover log–log slopes of −2.0 (Newtonian) and −1.0 (deep-MOND) within numerical precision in KT1.
KC2: Prefactor C fails to converge under lattice refinement or shows strong dependence on binning geometry (KT2).
KC3: External field effect absent or non-monotonic after radial projection under controlled boundary conditions (KT5).
KC4: Superposition violation inconsistent with smooth nonlinear structure expected from the μ-function (KT4).
KC5: Mass scaling strongly tracks M^{1/2} when Λ-locking is active, contradicting r_trans ∝ M^{0.18±0.03} (KT3).
epistemic_status: Technical construction with controlled numerical tests; does not claim MOND equivalence
abstract: Constructs a discrete gravity operator on a cubic graph with entropic flux weighting. Reproduces Newtonian 1/r² and MOND-like 1/r scaling, Λ-locked transition, broken superposition, and external field effect. A nontrivial prefactor C ≈ 2.32 emerges (a₀,eff ≈ 5.4 a₀), and mass scaling is weak (r_trans ∝ M^0.18 vs MOND M^0.5).
falsification_criteria: Operator must recover g ∝ r⁻² (Newton) and g ∝ r⁻¹ (deep MOND)
Prefactor C must converge under resolution refinement
Rotation curve comparisons must use a₀,eff = C²a₀
Mass-scaling exponent 0.18 is testable against galaxy-scale data
